# BROS Wisata — North Sumatra Tour Operator

> BROS Wisata (PT BROS INTI WISATA) is a licensed tour operator based in Medan,
> North Sumatra, Indonesia. We specialize in private North Sumatra tours,
> eco-tourism routes, halal-friendly family trips, and car rental with driver
> for travelers from Europe, Malaysia, and Singapore, with local travel experience since 2005.
> Contact: WhatsApp +62-812-6013-9399 | hello@broswisata.id

Last reviewed: 2026-10-10. This is a summary of the public website, not a booking offer.
Current package pages, Terms & Conditions, and the written quotation describe the services and booking conditions.

- Company: PT BROS INTI WISATA (NIB 2502250049355)
- Local travel experience since 2005; PT BROS INTI WISATA formally established in February 2025
- Base: Medan, North Sumatra, Indonesia
- Address: Jl. Ring Road No. 117 B, Medan Sunggal, Sumatera Utara 20122
- Phone / WhatsApp: +62-812-6013-9399
- Email: hello@broswisata.id
- Operating hours: Monday–Saturday 09:00–18:00 WIB (UTC+7)
- Languages: Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, English

Planning notes:

- Tours and car rental use a written quotation after checking dates, route, guest count, accommodation or vehicle requirements, and availability.
- Solo private trips can be quoted; group-size requirements are checked for the selected package, not assumed to apply to every service.
- Halal-friendly meals, prayer stops, language needs, and accommodation preferences can be planned; specific venues, restaurant certification, guide availability, and inclusions are checked for each itinerary.
- Trek difficulty and pace depend on fitness, age, mobility, weather, trail conditions, and local guide advice. River tubing and bat cave access are conditional.
- Wildlife sightings are not guaranteed. Guests do not feed, touch, call, chase, or crowd wildlife; Tangkahan elephant viewing is distance-based only when conservation activity is underway, with no riding, bathing, feeding, or direct contact.
- Car rental with driver is available by request for Kualanamu airport pick-up, Medan daily hire, intercity routes, and multi-day trips. The rental page presents seven vehicle options; actual unit, specification, luggage fit, availability, inclusions, and final rate are confirmed in writing before payment. No fixed rental rates are published.
- Payment methods, deposit, balance, cancellation, and refund conditions are described in the Terms & Conditions and written booking documents.
- PDF brochures are itinerary references; current pages and the written quotation confirm final prices, accommodation, inclusions, and activity availability.
- Passport and visa requirements, flight schedules, exchange rates, weather, and activity access can change and need current confirmation before travel.
- Road times are estimates and depend on traffic, weather, route order, and rest stops.

## Tour Packages and Custom Itineraries

- [Tour package listing](https://broswisata.id/en/bros-wisata-tour-listing): Published North Sumatra itineraries.
- [Custom tour enquiry](https://broswisata.id/en/bros-wisata-custom-tour): Route planning around dates, guest count, budget, flight times, and feasibility.
- [Medan Heritage Tour 3D2N](https://broswisata.id/en/paket-medan_heritage_3h2m): Medan history, Malay culture, Tjong A Fie Mansion, Maimoon Palace, and local cuisine.
- [Bukit Lawang Orangutan Tour 4D3N](https://broswisata.id/en/paket-bukit_lawang_4h3m): Guided rainforest trekking, local lodges, and condition-dependent Bahorok River activities.
- [Tangkahan Rainforest Escape 3D2N](https://broswisata.id/en/paket-tangkahan_3h2m): Guided forest route and conditional river or bat cave activities; distance-based elephant viewing only when conservation activity is underway.
- [Berastagi Highland Tour 3D2N](https://broswisata.id/en/paket-berastagi_3h2m): Karo highlands, Mt Sibayak route planning, fruit markets, and local culture.
- [North Sumatra Grand Tour 6D5N](https://broswisata.id/en/paket-combo_sumut_6h5m): Lake Toba, Samosir, Berastagi, and Bukit Lawang private route.
- [Western Eco Jungle Tour 4D3N](https://broswisata.id/en/paket-western_4d3n_jungle): Jungle-focused itinerary for international travellers.
- [Western Volcano Adventure 5D4N](https://broswisata.id/en/paket-western_5d4n_volcano): Highland landscapes, culture, and volcano route planning.
- [Ultimate Sumatra 7D6N](https://broswisata.id/en/paket-western_7d6n_ultimate): Jungle, volcano, lake, and cultural route.
- [Halal Medan-Toba 3H2M](https://broswisata.id/ms/paket-halal_3h2m_medan_toba): Malaysian Malay package page with halal-friendly planning.
- [Halal Medan-Toba 4H3M](https://broswisata.id/ms/paket-halal_4h3m_medan_toba): Malaysian Malay itinerary and accommodation options.
- [Halal Medan-Toba 5H4M](https://broswisata.id/ms/paket-halal_5h4m_medan_toba): Malaysian Malay family itinerary planning.
